description: This Java class 'ProductOptionValue' represents an entity in an e-commerce system, specifically modeling the value of a product option, including its attributes, relationships, and persistence annotations.

classes.name: ProductOptionValue
classes.description: Entity class representing a product option value, including properties for display order, image, code, descriptions, and related merchant store.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option value.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the product option value.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Gets the image filename associated with the product option value.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueImage
methods.description: Sets the image filename for the product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the set of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Gets the merchant store associated with this product option value.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option value.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this product option value.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Gets the list of descriptions for display or processing.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts the set of descriptions into a list, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the MultipartFile image associated with the value.

methods.name: isProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Checks if the option is display-only.

methods.name: setProductOptionDisplayOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the option is display-only.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for the product option value.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code of the product option value.
